name: University of the Arts London
summary: Art, design, fashion, media and performance only, across London colleges such as Central Saint Martins and Chelsea; your portfolio matters more than your points.

ib.text: On 2026-entry pages most BAs asked only 24–25 points (Architecture 35); applicants who meet that send a digital portfolio. IB English A at HL 5 or SL 6 proves your English.

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

notes: After UAL checks your UCAS application it asks for a digital portfolio through PebblePad; Fine Art, for example, allows at most 30 pages.
International fees for 2027 entry were not yet published; for 2026 entry a BA cost £30,890 a year, and fees can rise up to 5% a year during the course.
BA Architecture at Central Saint Martins will not continue as a standalone undergraduate degree beyond 2027, so check any architecture course carefully.
